t: DashGo : Next-Generation Record Label For Independent Artists, Managers and Labels
s: Ben Patterson founded and operates DashGo, a digital content distribution and services platform for independent artists, labels and content owners. DashGo provides online distribution, campaign execution and strategic marketing services. Since 2004, DashGo has focused on creating new revenue streams and promotional opportunities for artists and securing deals with Apple, YouTube, Emusic, Spotify, Hulu and most major DSPs worldwide.

Unlike traditional record labels, DashGo operates on a service-based model, allowing artists to retain 100% ownership of their music while providing the infrastructure needed to get their songs on platforms like Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, and many more.
